typography.anti_default_rule: NEVER use default Inter or generic sans for H1/H2 titles. Headlines must evoke rigorous scientific literature merged with computational vanguard.

colors.theme_description: Obsidian Deep Space with Cybernetic Emerald / Phosphor Mint and Amber Alert kinetic accents. Reflects financial microstructures, agent simulations, and digital twin telemetry.
colors.contrast_rules: APCA & WCAG AA certified: Body text #F8FAFC and #CBD5E1 on #07090E ensures >12:1 contrast. Explicit hover text colors required on all interactive elements (e.g., hover:text-white hover:bg-emerald-600).

visual_enhancers.canvas_simulation: Interactive Canvas ABM Particle Network in the hero showing agents colliding, clustering, and responding to simulated liquidity shocks or market sentiment toggles.
visual_enhancers.grid_overlay: Subtle 40px SVG blueprint grid with 3% opacity background texture (no flat digital void).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#07090E]/80 border border-white/10 for sticky navbar and floating telemetry panels.
visual_enhancers.badges: Bordered monospace chips with pulsing radar dots for lab affiliations (UFRJ · PPGI · CEFET/RJ Maria da Graça).

grid_modes.public_sections: Mode A: Tetris Grid with asymmetric spans (col-span-8 dominant telemetry card + col-span-4 stacked agent specs).
grid_modes.admin_dashboard: Mode B: High-Density Swiss Layout with strict 4-column widget ratios, quick-filter tabs, and data tables.

layout_strategy.spacing_scale: Tailwind 2x-3x generous spacing: section padding py-24 sm:py-32, container max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8, gap-8 to gap-12 between asymmetric bento blocks.

pt.badge: LABORATÓRIO DE PESQUISA AVANÇADA · UFRJ / CEFET-RJ
pt.title: Mundos Artificiais em Finanças
pt.subtitle: Simulações complexas, ecossistemas multiagente (ABMS) e inteligência artificial para antecipar a emergência e o risco em mercados financeiros.

en.title: Artificial Worlds in Finance
en.subtitle: Complex simulations, agent-based modeling (ABMS), and artificial intelligence engineered to uncover emergent dynamics and systemic market risk.

hero_section.interactive_agent_canvas: An embedded canvas rendering 150 autonomous synthetic investor agents (Fundamentalists, Chartists, Noise Traders) with dynamic price trajectory and crash/recovery states.

topics.desc_pt: Micromundos com milhares de agentes cognitivos autônomos para modelar book de ofertas, liquidez endógena e dinâmica de flash crashes.
topics.desc_en: Microscopic synthetic markets with thousands of autonomous cognitive agents modeling limit order books, endogenous liquidity, and flash crashes.

topics.desc_pt: Réplicas virtuais de alta fidelidade para testar estresse de fluxos de caixa, choques macroeconômicos e estabilidade sistêmica bancária.
topics.desc_en: High-fidelity virtual replicas designed to stress-test corporate cash flows, macroeconomic perturbations, and interbank systemic resilience.

topics.desc_pt: Redes neurais e aprendizado por reforço simulando viés de aversão à perda, histeria de contágio e formação de bolhas especulativas.
topics.desc_en: Deep reinforcement learning agents reproducing cognitive heuristics, herd behavior, panic contagions, and speculative asset bubbles.

topics.desc_pt: Padronização metodológica internacional (Overview, Design concepts, Details) assegurando reprodutibilidade matemática rigorosa.
topics.desc_en: Standardized international methodological framework (Overview, Design concepts, Details) guaranteeing rigorous simulation reproducibility.

topics.desc_pt: Modelagem em escala paralela com integração a dados de alta frequência e cenários de política monetária.
topics.desc_en: Massively parallel simulation pipelines integrated with tick-level market microstructure data and monetary policy scenarios.

team_section.structure: Grid of 6 researchers (5 professors + 1 master's researcher) with interactive modal/drawer showing comprehensive academic background, Lattes CV, research interests, and top publications.

members.name: Prof. Dr. Eduardo Bezerra
members.bio_pt: Doutor em Engenharia de Sistemas e Computação (COPPE/UFRJ). Especialista em aprendizado de máquina e simulação de agentes autônomos em ambientes econômicos competitivos.
members.bio_en: Ph.D. in Systems Engineering and Computer Science (COPPE/UFRJ). Expert in machine learning and autonomous agent simulations in competitive economic environments.

members.name: Profa. Dra. Rafaela Brum
members.role_pt: Professora Associada & Pesquisadora em Finanças Quantitativas
members.bio_pt: Doutora com vasta atuação na modelagem de Digital Twins financeiros e arquitetura de agentes para previsão de liquidez sob choques extremos.
members.bio_en: Ph.D. with recognized work on financial digital twins and behavioral agent architectures forecasting liquidity stress under extreme tail risk.

members.name: Prof. Dr. Marcos Marques
members.bio_pt: Foco em arquiteturas distribuídas para simulações financeiras de larga escala e validação de modelos pelo protocolo científico ODD.
members.bio_en: Specializes in scalable distributed simulation architectures and formal model validation via the international ODD scientific protocol.

members.name: Prof. Dr. Alexandre Vasconcelos
members.role_pt: Professor Pesquisador & Especialista em Séries Temporais
members.bio_pt: Pesquisador no PPGI/UFRJ investigando a transição de regimes de volatilidade e redes neurais recorrentes aplicadas à microestrutura de negociação.
members.bio_en: Researcher at PPGI/UFRJ investigating volatility regime switching and recurrent neural networks applied to high-frequency order books.

members.name: Profa. Dra. Camila Almeida
members.role_pt: Professora Pesquisadora em Regulação e Mercados de Capitais
members.role_en: Research Professor in Regulation & Capital Markets
members.bio_pt: Atua na interface entre regulação prudencial do Banco Central/CVM e ambientes de teste em sandbox baseados em simulações sintéticas de mercado.
members.bio_en: Works at the frontier of regulatory policy stress testing (CVM/Central Bank) utilizing synthetic financial sandboxes and agent populations.

members.name: Gabriel Santos, M.Sc. Candidate
members.bio_pt: Desenvolve dissertação focada em agentes dotados de modelos de linguagem para replicação de cascatas informacionais e contágio no mercado acionário brasileiro.
members.bio_en: Conducting master's research on LLM-driven agents mimicking information cascades and panic contagion in the Brazilian equities market.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the React frontend in JavaScript (.js / .jsx), strictly respecting pre-configured Shadcn components and Tailwind CSS.
Deliver a genuine bilingual experience (PT-BR and EN) with an active context state switchable anytime from the top bar.
Build a custom HTML5 canvas agent simulation in the Hero with interactive controls (e.g. 'Shock Market / Choque de Liquidez') illustrating ABMS.
Incorporate real faculty profiles from UFRJ PPGI and CEFET/RJ Maria da Graça with education, research focus, Lattes CV buttons, and publication modals.
Integrate FastAPI MongoDB backend for Publications, News, and Contact inquiries with full CRUD for the Admin dashboard.
Use Sonner for toasts upon actions like citation copying, feedback messages, and news updates.
Ensure contrast standards are met across all dark surfaces (no muddy low-contrast grey on black).
